board_note: Enter measured inner corner counts and square_mm for the actual flat physical target; no dimensions are assumed.

synchronization.note: The skew limit is an internal placeholder, not achieved sync. Camera/USB arrival timestamps and filename order cannot establish simultaneous exposures. Record a shared exposure clock and reviewed physical timing evidence.

instructions: Copy pair_template into pairs for each explicitly matched capture; never infer pairs by sorting filenames.
Set provenance=real_paired_camera_captures only for actual paired physical-camera images, never synthetic or display rephotography data.
Provide at least 8 training and 3 separate held_out pairs; capture many more distinct centre/edge/tilted board poses for real acceptance.
Reserve held_out pairs before fitting; list calibration_image_sha256 in both intrinsic profiles to audit intrinsic/held-out leakage.
Each intrinsic profile requires model=fisheye, K, D[4], image_size, camera_id, lens_id, profile_id and provenance=real_chessboard_captures.
Only after a human reviews actual exposure timing evidence may evidence_review_status be user_verified_hardware_evidence; this software hashes the evidence but does not interpret the trace.
This template contains no real camera parameters, real captures, verified timing, baseline, stereo depth or hardware-release permission.
